goal.en: Execute the requested sequential UX flows with scoped account/seed setup, real screenshot/video evidence and verified cleanup.

sideEffects: owned prerequisite SQL seed and cleanup
declared product UI actions and explicitly authorized paid AI calls
direct provider/resource cleanup for exact run-owned IDs

graphPolicy.location: .starciwork node dependsOn/refs with direct sourceRefs and collocated assets

purpose.en: Read the existing selected N/index.yaml, ancestor scope, declared refs/dependencies/assertions and validator freshness. This consumer op requires its target node to exist. An absent target is a scope/graph gap: report it and propose a separately selected scope op; do not create a target or invent its acceptance/graph here.

Read accepted requirements, decisions, constraints and acceptance IDs declared as relevant inputs in the selected .starciwork graph. Intent governs expected behavior; source is not a replacement. Do not invent a mandatory BA predecessor for a scope that does not require one; a needed missing input is a reported graph/scope gap, not a new dependency silently added here.

When source exists/is selected, resolve repository resource, actual checkout/root/HEAD and dirty state; read applicable instructions, manifests, owning code, callers and relevant tests. Greenfield/spec-only work records source not-yet-created and grounds intent in the user request; no invented repository or fact citation. Source implementation still needs an actual selected writable repository.
Read exact target/origins, owner, configuration revision, declared probes and allowed effects; validate live observations without inferring identity from hostname alone.

Read the finite ordered flows array from the accepted FE E/flows.json or its exact selected workflow request. Preserve the FE commit/runtime binding; a different served build requires reconciliation before execution. Do not regenerate or weaken business expectations. Each selected flow maps to an existing target and specifies entry, actor role, ordered actions, expected business outcomes, observed-feedback checks, fixture needs, effects and cleanup. Preserve array order and step order; no flow fan-out or successor dispatch. Material missing expectations are resolved before mutation, not guessed from current behavior.

reads.path: .starciwork/_resources/identities/<identity>/resource.yaml + selected account requirements and sealed custody

purpose.en: Resolve an existing suitable test account, role, membership and credential custody; otherwise create a scoped test account through the actual supported identity owner when the UAT request authorizes account setup. Reuse is the first choice, never reset a shared password. Planned identity slots must already be in selected scope; write actual provider IDs only after observing creation. Preserve reused accounts and record whether a new account is disposable or explicitly retained.

reads.path: .starciwork/_resources/fixtures/<fixture>/resource.yaml + actual selected database schema and seed preconditions

purpose.en: Inspect actual schema, constraints, existing fixture state and required preconditions. Seed prerequisites only, never pre-create the action outcome under test. Resolve database/environment identity and the run-owned namespace; do not guess SQL tables or use broad table deletion.

Inspect reusable seed SQL, cleanup SQL and resource-management scripts and the real APIs they call. Create missing scripts inside the selected automation source scope from the actual schema/SDK/API. Keep test plumbing separate from product repairs. Record script versions and use sealed credentials at execution time, never in tracked source or evidence.

reads.path: current request authorization + selected environment/provider resources and configured spend limits

purpose.en: Bind account creation, SQL seed/delete, product actions, resource creation/deletion and paid AI calls to the selected flows. Reuse explicit user authorization for paid AI testing without another approval per call; use actual configured models/providers and any stated limits, record usage/cost when observable and otherwise unavailable. This is not unlimited unrelated spending or an invitation to retry forever. Discover deletion and post-delete verification capability before creating billable resources.

reads.path: selected workflow request + workflows/contracts.json + this op authority.json

purpose.en: When selected inside the named workflow, read the exact request, strict response contract and primary/secondary authority JSON. Standalone op execution does not invent a workflow request.

Only when explicitly selected in a job matrix, read the exact cell ID, operation, immutable input bindings, requested output JSON shapes and required criteria. Standalone execution needs no fabricated matrix request. A template is not authority for extra effects.

reads.path: profiles/registry.json + selected runtime execution profile + actual host tools/model

purpose.en: Select the actual host runtime codex or claude and this operator role from the V2-derived active profiles. Use current host model configuration; historical model names are not availability proof. Capabilities are the intersection of actual tools, selected profile policy, op permissions and existing task authority. Do not revive V2 dispatch chains, retired profiles or extra-agent permissions.

content.en: Read the existing selected scope, expected assertions and .starciwork graph unchanged. Write only state/blocker/completion here; actual observations, findings, commit mappings and remaining cleanup belong to the evidence result, not semantic node prose. Missing refs/dependencies/acceptance require a reported gap or separately selected scope update; never add/remove them to obtain pass.

Reuse or create scripts for account setup where needed, idempotent prerequisite seed, run-owned SQL deletion, provider resource inspection/create/delete and cleanup verification. Require a stable run ID, exact recorded IDs, environment/account ownership checks, dry-run/plan inspection, parameterized SQL, transactions where supported, idempotent cleanup and nonzero failure exits. Do not modify business code, expected outcomes, database schema or apply production migrations.

fields: details: actual IDs and sealed refs only

content.en: Fill or refresh only already selected identity/fixture resource slots after observing real setup. Finalize semantic IDs, revisions and custody refs before computing the verification input digest. Preserve reusable identity records; per-run effects and cleanup results belong to evidence rather than post-proof resource edits.

writes.path: E/manifest.yaml + E/run-ledger.json + E/script-review.md + E/seed.json + E/flows.json + E/ux-checks.json + E/walk.json + E/screens/*.png + E/videos/* + E/readback.json + E/runtime.json + E/cleanup.json + E/costs.json + E/result.md

content.en: Keep request flow order, original assertion IDs, actual locators/actions and business results, per-check expected yes/no and observed yes/no, screenshots and playable real browser video indexed by flow/step/time. For unobserved checks keep actual null with not-run/inconclusive outside the yes/no answer column. Record stable run ID, reused versus created objects, immediate returned resource IDs, provider correlation IDs, script hashes/commands/exits, before/after read-back and cleanup ownership/results. A screenshot or silent video alone cannot prove a business outcome. Redact credentials, PII and sensitive video frames; hash the final sanitized playable assets. Operator-specific observed result in E/result.md: Preserve expected flows and business assertions; keep per-flow outcomes, yes/no UX observations, original failures and cleanup results in evidence. Done requires the selected journeys and required cleanup to pass.

Only for the selected named workflow, emit the response defined by workflows/contracts.json. Return outputs.results for every input flow and step in order, yes/no UX observations and screenshot/video evidence, plus outputs.cleanup with no unresolved owned resources for a pass. A failed/blocked response preserves evidence with outputs:null.

Only for a selected job matrix, return the exact request-bound result. Populate every declared cell output with actual canonical Work/source/runtime references or produced JSON artifacts from this job; retain real artifact bytes and hashes. Do not rename/regenerate upstream expectations. Missing required output/evidence remains blocked or failed and cannot advance. The selected request freezes output field schemas before execution.

action.en: Freeze the requested flows order, business expectations and applicable UX checks before effects. UX answers are yes/no for observed loading feedback, error feedback, skeleton, validation, retry/recovery and completion as requested; no beauty, spacing, color, typography or visual-fidelity scoring. Specify expected yes or no and applicability before running; a skeleton is not universally required and no error on a happy path is not automatically a failure. Verify runtime/served identity and actual screenshot/video capability before starting. Own case preparation within this invocation: map every requested flow and step to accepted ACs, actor, entry, preconditions, feedback, persistent read-back where required, real screenshot/video checkpoints and cleanup obligations before effects. Locator choices never redefine expected behavior. No plan/account/seed predecessor is required. Resolve the execution profile and actual tool availability before selecting instruments; this does not switch the model/runtime or spawn workers. Read the FE asset manifest and preserve explicit deferred artwork status. Test business/UX expectations only; cosmetic artwork may remain pending under the accepted profile policy, but missing assets required by a requested flow cannot satisfy its criteria.

Inspect or author the missing seed/delete/resource-management scripts from actual owners. Review dry-run targets and failure behavior, test their guards without destructive product effects, and prepare a finally-style cleanup path before the first mutation. The run ledger records reused baselines and every created/mutated ID immediately; discover unknown provider outcomes by read-only correlation before retries.

Reuse a suitable account or create the authorized scoped account through its supported provider/script; verify actual login, role and membership. Resolve credentials at use time and isolate browser sessions for distinct actors while retaining the session continuity each sequential flow requires. Track disposable account ownership separately from reused identities.

Execute reviewed parameterized seed SQL only for missing prerequisites, recording exact inserted IDs and before-images for any authorized changes to reused records. Verify preconditions by read-back. Finalize identity/fixture metadata and compute the actual verification digest before starting the tested journeys; never seed a successful outcome or fabricate a passing prerequisite.

Run flows[0], flows[1], and so on in the requested order, each action in its declared sequence, with real browser controls and continuous real video per flow. Capture screenshots at significant steps, loading/error/skeleton observations and failure points. Real configured paid AI calls are permitted within the authorized flow; do not substitute mocked AI success. Record asynchronous operation/resource IDs promptly and verify actual completion, not merely request acceptance.

For each reached checkpoint answer observed UX checks yes/no only, linked to screenshot/video timestamps. Verify expected business results through actual response, reload/resume and authorized read-only API/SQL read-back; API writes never perform an action claimed as UI-tested. Preserve failures; dependent later steps are not-run, while independent later flows may proceed only in original order with safe preconditions. Do not repair product code or rewrite expected outcomes inside UAT.

After success, failure or interruption, finalize and inspect the real recordings/screens and run the prepared cleanup for all owned effects. Delete externally provisioned resources through the supported direct provider/API script using exact ledger IDs before removing local metadata; SQL deletion alone cannot delete a VM or stop billing. Poll/reconcile actual absence or provider deletion completion and dependent owned resources. Run cleanup SQL in dependency-safe order, restore authorized reused-record before-images and remove disposable accounts only when owned and selected for cleanup. Preserve shared/reused objects and explicitly retained prerequisites; never broad-delete by age or name prefix alone.

Read back database and provider state to prove cleanup, retaining the ownership ledger, scripts and sanitized evidence. If a resource remains, record exact IDs, costs when observable and an executable resume-cleanup command; incomplete cleanup blocks overall done even when flows passed. Report each flow result, the yes/no UX table, screenshot/video refs, usage/cost observations and cleanup result. Validate bound evidence and stop; never claim the journey succeeded solely because cleanup succeeded. For workflow execution, Return outputs.results for every input flow and step in order, yes/no UX observations and screenshot/video evidence, plus outputs.cleanup with no unresolved owned resources for a pass. Submit the exact response to the coordinator gate; never self-advance. When selected in a job matrix, produce E/job-result.json bound to the exact request, its output schema and every required criterion. This handoff is conditional and does not change standalone or named frontend response contracts.

requirement.en: Run workspace validation; every cited ID/path exists or is explicitly proposed, required assertions are covered, input bindings are current, and an honest not-run/fail cannot earn done.

Every requested flow and action retains its order, real execution status and original expected outcome; dependent unreached steps are not-run and no parallel flow execution is presented as sequential.

Actual rendered controls produced each required business outcome with a passing behavior assertion, verified served version and required persistence/negative checks. Paid AI results are actual provider outcomes, not a fake placeholder.

Each observed applicable UX answer is yes or no with expected value and direct evidence; unobserved checks stay null plus not-run/inconclusive. No appearance score is produced and required failed checks block completion.

Every executed flow has finalized playable genuine video and indexed screenshots for its required checkpoints, verified after redaction. Missing recording cannot be replaced by generated video or stills labelled as footage.

Seed, delete and resource-management scripts are real inspected reusable source with exact environment/run ownership guards and observed exits; setup/cleanup output records actual IDs and failures, not illustrative SQL or fake provider APIs.

Every run-owned created resource/row/account selected for deletion is confirmed absent through its real owner, reused mutations are restored where authorized, and retained objects have explicit ownership reasons. Partial setup, failed flows and uncertain asynchronous effects remain in the cleanup ledger until resolved; unfinished cleanup cannot earn done.

condition.en: The ordered flows array, original expected behavior or required target bindings are missing or ambiguous.
Account custody, actual seed schema/client, runtime or owned setup prerequisite cannot be established within the selected scope.
The permitted browser cannot capture required genuine video/screenshots or the final sanitized files cannot be played/read.
An effect exceeds the selected account/data/provider/paid-AI authority or stated spending limits.
Exact owned resource deletion/restoration remains unverified; retain IDs/evidence and a resumable cleanup command, never erase the ledger or claim done.

A declared prerequisite is not effectively done, or a required declared input/scope is missing. Report node/resource IDs and propose a separately selected graph update when needed; never run predecessors or weaken dependsOn/refs/required to proceed.

placeholders.repo-id: Resolved direct repository name or path
